news.title: New Google commercial imagines a Declaration of Independence written with help from AI
news.description: Two hundred and fifty years after the signing of the Declaration of Independence, a new commercial asks: What if the Founding Fathers had access to Google Workspace?

news.title: Midjourney wants Hollywood studios to reveal the details of their AI usage
news.description: As part of an ongoing legal dispute with three Hollywood studios, Midjourney is seeking to compel those studios to reveal how they use AI themselves.

news.title: Alibaba reportedly bans employees from using Claude Code
news.description: Alibaba has reportedly classified Claude Code as high-risk software.

news.title: What is Mistral AI? Everything to know about the OpenAI competitor
news.description: Mistral AI, which offers some open source AI models, has raised significant funding since its creation in 2023, with the ambition to “put frontier AI in the hands of everyone.”

news.title: Parents warned not to publicly share children’s images amid AI abuse risks
news.description: The NCA says there is a growing threat of children's images being used to create child abuse material.

news.title: AI is 'not smart' so what's next in artificial intelligence?
news.description: Leading AI researcher Yan LeCun has a start-up which is developing a more flexible AI system.

news.title: Can Cursor Remain a Platform for OpenAI and Anthropic’s Models Inside SpaceX?
news.description: Cursor hopes to continue offering third-party AI models after it's acquired by SpaceX, testing the relationships between frontier AI labs.

news.title: You Can Now Sound the Alarm on AI Behaving Badly
news.description: Are you worried your AI chatbot is trying to build a bomb or leak personal information about you? There’s a website for that.
